scientific_question: Can a compact action-format prompt restore fallback-free greedy behavior and non-zero reward for the frozen SUCCESS adapter?
hypothesis: H1.3 shows that extra output budget restores some SUCCESS validity but not reward; requiring short reasoning plus an explicit two-line action format will reduce remaining parser failures and expose whether policy quality, rather than formatting, limits reward.

prompt_regimes.name: baseline_v1_reference
prompt_regimes.source: sealed H1.3 repair greedy512 results; no duplicate rollout

scientific_control: baseline_v1_reference is the H1.3 repair greedy512 arm matched on task, seed, model, adapter, and evaluator; only compact_v2 is newly generated.

frozen_variables.runtime_gpu_contract: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES exactly one selected GPU UUID

compact_prompt_contract.name: seed3090.webshop-compact-action-prompt.v2
compact_prompt_contract.instruction: Keep reasoning under 30 words. Output exactly two tagged lines: <think>brief reason</think> and <action>one admissible action</action>. Do not list products, repeat the instruction, or write text after </action>.

primary_metrics: compact-minus-baseline paired reward and validity deltas

execution.new_cells: 3 arms x 2 partitions = 6 compact_v2 cells; 8 attempts per cell
execution.baseline: reuse sealed H1.3 repair greedy512 artifacts as reference
execution.gpu_policy: one UUID-bound process per cell; launch only on verified idle GPUs; do not fill remaining cards with duplicate deterministic baseline

stop_branch.contract_and_reward_rescue: if SUCCESS compact_v2 reaches >=12/16 valid and >=2 qualified positives, queue a frozen recovery/action-calibration panel; D0 remains closed
stop_branch.contract_only: if validity reaches threshold but qualified positives remain below 2, retain contract-only evidence and diagnose state distribution
stop_branch.no_rescue: preserve negative evidence; do not change adapter rank/LR/epochs
stop_branch.runtime_failure: exclude and preserve artifacts; repair in a new group

claim_boundary: Bounded prompt/action-format diagnostic on four frozen WebShop tasks; no benchmark claim and D0 remains closed.
